items.title: Pilgrim Woman Spinning Wool
items.alt: A woman in a green waistcoat, brown petticoat and linen coif spins wool with a hanging drop spindle beside a small wool basket.
items.description: A woman in a green waistcoat, brown petticoat and linen coif spins wool with a hanging drop spindle beside a small wool basket. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Child Winding Wool
items.alt: A seated child in blue and brown clothing winds undyed wool between a hand-held wooden frame and a ball on the lap.
items.description: A seated child in blue and brown clothing winds undyed wool between a hand-held wooden frame and a ball on the lap. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Carpenter Planing a Board
items.alt: A man in a brown doublet and green breeches pushes a wooden hand plane along a supported board on a carpenter bench.
items.description: A man in a brown doublet and green breeches pushes a wooden hand plane along a supported board on a carpenter bench. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Cooper Fitting a Barrel
items.alt: A kneeling cooper in a russet doublet and linen apron adjusts a hoop around a wooden stave barrel beside a resting mallet.
items.description: A kneeling cooper in a russet doublet and linen apron adjusts a hoop around a wooden stave barrel beside a resting mallet. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Basket Weaving
items.alt: A seated woman in a blue waistcoat, brown apron and linen coif weaves upright willow rods into a round basket.
items.description: A seated woman in a blue waistcoat, brown apron and linen coif weaves upright willow rods into a round basket. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Spoon Carver
items.alt: A seated man in a green doublet and linen apron holds a partly shaped wooden spoon above a low workbench with shavings and a resting carving knife.
